description.value: The Bon Voyage Inn is a family-friendly motel on the Yellowhead Highway (Highway 16 West) at the western edge of Prince George, offering room types ranging from twin and queen rooms to family suites and a Jacuzzi suite, as well as adjoining rooms for groups of up to six. The property sits within the Bon Voyage Plaza, putting an on-site restaurant, laundry, and retail stores steps from the guest rooms. Pet-friendly rooms, winter vehicle plug-ins, and on-site RV power and water hookups make it a practical overnight stop on the Yellowhead corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and corroborates the OSM record: phone 1-250-964-2333, address 4222 Highway 16 (West) Prince George V2N 5N7, and website URL all match. The site confirms free Wi-Fi, pet-friendly rooms, wheelchair-accessible rooms, and an adjoining restaurant plus plaza with laundry and stores nearby. No mention of secure bike storage, bike-specific procedures, e-bike charging, or any other cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site. The restaurant subpage contains clearly mismatched spa/health-club placeholder text that was never removed from the template.
concerns: OSM addr:street lists 'Yellowhead Highway'; website consistently uses 'Highway 16 (West)' — same road, minor naming variation, no action required.

Restaurant subpage contains unmistakably mismatched placeholder/template text referencing a spa, health club, pool lifeguard policy, and spa treatment etiquette — content was never replaced with real restaurant information. Does not affect accommodation listing validity but suggests the website is not fully maintained.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating motel with an active website, current booking calendar, and confirmed contact details. Useful overnight stop on the Yellowhead cycling corridor.

Laundry.detail: Laundry available in the adjacent Bon Voyage Plaza: 'Just outside your door there are restaurants, laundry, and stores.'

Nearby evening food.detail: Adjoining Bon Voyage Restaurant on site; additional restaurants in the Bon Voyage Plaza immediately adjacent
